title: Now an elder statesman, former Gov. Gray Davis surveys his career in a major Berkeley project
summary: After 17 lengthy recording sessions and more than a decade of review and revision, Davis and the Oral History Center at Bancroft Library are releasing their monumental history of a career that helped shape modern California. The post Now an elder statesman, former Gov. Gray Davis surveys his career in a major Berkeley project appeared first on Berkeley News .
author: Edward Lempinen
